capabilities: Intercepts desktop window close and raises a reflection prompt
Renders an editable title, Markdown body and configurable action buttons
Lets buttons cancel the quit, close the app, open a note, run a command or open a URL
Edits content in a modal with a live Markdown editor and linked-note mode
Answers mobile back-button and home-screen gestures behind toggles
extras: No network access, telemetry or analytics; diagnostics file and developer trace log are off by default. Limitations: best-effort only (crashes and forced kills skip it), breaks 'Reload app without saving', relies on private Obsidian/Electron internals, and the latest Windows close-guard change was validated only on Windows with Obsidian 1.14.4.
problem: Obsidian closes immediately on quit, giving no chance to pause, review where you are, or capture something before leaving.

relations.evidence: The embedded Markdown editor in src/markdown-editor.ts is ported from EmbeddableMarkdownEditor by Fevol
with the prototype-extraction technique originally from mgmeyers/obsidian-kanban

summary: Quit-interception plugin that shows a reflection prompt with an editable Markdown body and action buttons before the Obsidian window closes.
